basis: The statute (PDF pages 1, 9 and 11) constitutes the Associazione per la Galleria d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea di Bergamo and has its Consiglio direttivo name the director after the opinion of the city executive (Giunta Comunale).
The Chi siamo page, section Fondazione Museion, states that since 2006 Museion is a private-law foundation that includes the Autonomous Province of Bolzano and the Museion Private Founders.
The About page states that Antonio Ratti created the non-profit foundation in 1985 and lists it as Fondazione Antonio Ratti ETS with its own Board of Directors.
The About us page says the project was started in 1999 with the Cooperativa il Gaviale and its footer names IL GAVIALE società cooperativa as the entity at via Gramsci 13, Dro.

The 2025 annual report (PDF page 21, Governance) calls it a recognised public-private foundation registered at the Prefettura of Florence, run by an autonomous Board of Trustees with an independent chair.

The Ministry of Culture page lists the Gallerie degli Uffizi as an office of the Ministry with special autonomy at general directorate level, and annex 1 of the ministerial decree of 9 February 2024 (PDF page 3) names it among those offices.

The 2019 institutional report (PDF pages 3 and 4) gives its legal status as Foundation, quotes article 2 of its by-laws and says it was established in 2014 as a non-profit organisation under Italian law.

The Corte dei conti report to Parliament on financial year 2022, transmitted December 2024 (PDF pages 11, 12, 16, 20 and 32), describes a foundation under the Ministry of Culture's supervision, governed by its board and bound by the public contracts code.
